notes: Fixes shared-user Safety access buttons being swallowed by older People/Admin click handlers. Give Safety access, Edit access, Save access, password reset and Refresh users now use a window-level capture handler that runs before legacy document handlers. Access buttons are full-width/easier to tap on mobile. v2.11.48 shared-to-Safety account linking, creator-only new-site access and v2.11.47 targeted incident review remain unchanged. No database migration required.
